description: A laminated card screwed to the wall at eye height beside the vats, the corners furred from a decade of thumbs. COLDWATER CLONE FACILITY — CONDITIONS OF DISCHARGE. Beneath, in the flat voice of something written by committee: "1. You are released in good standing. 2. Property recovered from your prior instance, if any, is not held here. 3. Nutrition is available at the dispenser to your left at no charge and no limit; do not attempt to remove the dispenser. 4. The facility does not equip. TWO-CELL SUPPLY, two doors east on Ironside, trades in essentials at posted prices. 5. Do not re-enter the vat hall." Someone has inked beneath the last line, in small neat capitals: THEY MEAN IT.
name: a laminated discharge notice
